summary: A third GPU thread, HOME shortcuts and three game updates.

changes.title: A third GPU thread
changes.body: Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws use a third recording thread.

changes.title: Ocarina of Time above 60 FPS
changes.body: FPS Unlock fixes Epona's fence jump, the day/night clock and the Deku Tree webs.

changes.title: Switch 2 games in HOME
changes.body: Play games from your folders in HOME without installing them.

changes.title: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition
changes.body: Fixes title-screen textures and a docked/handheld crash.

changes.title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
changes.body: Invalid Vulkan texture-buffer views no longer crash the game.
